requirements.Title: AI Productivity Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity features for print, scan, and workflow management to enhance ease of use for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: AI solutions are a key differentiator and address the pain point of non-IT trained decision makers needing efficient, easy-to-manage tools.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires consolidated SMB portal and integration with device management platform.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-driven print/scan workflows demonstrably reduce manual steps by at least 30% compared to standard workflows; available at launch; validated through user testing with SMBs.

requirements.Title: Consolidated SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a centralized portal specifically for SMBs to manage multiple HP printers, including device status, usage, maintenance, and support.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged and lightly managed SMBs lack dedicated IT; a consolidated portal simplifies printer management and enhances customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on secure device connectivity and integration with AI solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal allows management of at least 15 devices per account, includes real-time status, maintenance alerts, and usage analytics; passes usability tests with SMB office managers.

requirements.Title: Low Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Business Tank Printer
requirements.Description: Deliver HP's lowest business TCO in a tank printer form factor, targeting SMBs with high efficiency and cost savings.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs seek ROI and efficiency; TCO is a primary purchase driver and competitive differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires efficient ink tank design, high yield consumables, and minimal maintenance architecture.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product TCO is 10% lower than nearest HP business printer competitor and 15% lower than leading market competitor; verified by internal cost analysis.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design the maintenance box to be easily replaceable by the customer, reducing downtime and service costs for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack IT support; customer replaceability minimizes disruption and aligns with market expectations for serviceability.
requirements.Dependencies: Must meet warranty and serviceability guidelines; compatible with PHA/MINK strategies.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by customer in under 3 minutes without tools; validated by usability testing with non-IT users.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Achieve at least 60% recycled content plastic in the printer’s construction, surpassing main competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a top priority for SMBs and a competitive differentiator (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Dependencies: Supply chain capability for high RCP materials; compliance with environmental standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: External and internal plastic parts comprise at least 60% post-consumer recycled content; verified by third-party audit.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles for Refilling
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent misfilling and ensure correct refills for each color.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user error, improves reliability, and aligns with HP’s quality standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new bottle and tank interface design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles are incompatible with incorrect tanks; validated by 100% success rate in user testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability – 80K Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty covering either 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first, with clear serviceability guidelines (customer replaceable parts, service center support).
requirements.Rationale: Clear warranty and serviceability reduce SMB risk and support purchase decisions.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires robust part durability and clear customer support documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms published; 95% of parts meet durability targets; service process validated by pilot SMB customers.

requirements.Title: SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB Portal Support (Non-PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Ensure the non-PDL SKU supports SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal for enhanced manageability and solutions integration.
requirements.Rationale: Supports differentiated solutions offering for non-PDL configurations, catering to SMB needs for manageability.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software integration and portal readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU ships with SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View portal enabled; functionality validated in QA.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Platform as a Service) Support
requirements.Description: Enable Platform as a Service support for both PDL and non-PDL SKUs to allow for flexible business models and future solutions deployment.
requirements.Rationale: PaaS support aligns with HP’s strategic intent to accelerate service-based offerings and future-proofs the platform.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires backend platform integration and licensing models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS functionality enabled and documented for both SKUs at launch.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU: Enhanced Print Speed and PDL/PS Support
requirements.Description: For PDL SKU, deliver a minimum print speed of 25/20 ppm (improved from current 25/19), with PDL/PS (Page Description Language/PostScript) support.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses higher-end SMB needs for speed and compatibility with advanced print workflows.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware and firmware capability for speed and PDL/PS support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves 25/20 ppm in standard test; PDL/PS compatibility verified with 100% pass on standard file set.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification (PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Obtain Blue Angel eco-label certification for the PDL SKU to meet environmental and market requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Required for market access in regions where Blue Angel is mandatory and to support sustainability claims.
requirements.Dependencies: Product design must meet Blue Angel criteria.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU listed on Blue Angel registry at launch.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan Solutions
requirements.Description: Develop and integrate 'Perfect Print' and 'Perfect Scan' solutions powered by AI for superior output quality and reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB need for high-quality, error-free output with minimal intervention.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI productivity platform and hardware compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Perfect Print/Scan features enabled; 95% of test jobs meet quality benchmarks; validated by SMB customer feedback.

requirements.Title: Reduced Maintenance and Fewer Replaceable Parts
requirements.Description: Design the printer for minimal maintenance, with fewer parts needing replacement over its lifetime.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces TCO and increases appeal to SMBs with limited IT support; competitive differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Must not compromise reliability or warranty.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer requires 30% fewer maintenance interventions than comparable models; validated by field testing.

requirements.Title: Comprehensive Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement robust telemetry to capture device health, usage, error states, and provide actionable insights to users and HP support.
requirements.Rationale: Supports proactive maintenance, enhances user experience, and enables future AI-driven solutions.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires secure data transmission and integration with SMB portal.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data available in portal; 98% uptime in telemetry transmission during pilot.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing capabilities through the HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile printing is a key use case for modern SMBs and a competitive necessity.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires HP App integration and device compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile print jobs can be initiated and completed from HP App with a 95% success rate in SMB user testing.
